description: This file defines classes and functions for filtering graph IDs and routing graphs to different backends based on ID ranges and conditions, primarily used in the context of PyTorch's compilation and backend selection mechanisms.

classes.name: GraphIdFilter
classes.description: A filter class for matching graph IDs based on explicit IDs, ranges, and comparison operators.

classes.name: GraphBackendRouter
classes.description: A router class that assigns backends to graph IDs based on configured rules and conditions.

methods.name: lookup_backend_with_mode
methods.description: Looks up a backend supporting 'backend:mode' format, especially for inductor backends.

methods.name: GraphIdFilter.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the filter with a string specifying IDs, ranges, or conditions.

methods.name: GraphIdFilter._parse
methods.description: Parses the filter string into explicit IDs and conditions.

methods.name: GraphIdFilter.__contains__
methods.description: Checks if a given graph ID matches the filter.

methods.name: GraphBackendRouter.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the router with a configuration string defining rules.

methods.name: GraphBackendRouter._parse
methods.description: Parses the configuration string into rules.

methods.name: GraphBackendRouter._precompute
methods.description: Precomputes backend assignments for IDs up to the maximum specified.

methods.name: GraphBackendRouter._match_rules
methods.description: Matches a graph ID against the rules to find the corresponding backend.

methods.name: GraphBackendRouter.get_backend_for_graph
methods.description: Returns the backend assigned to a specific graph ID.

methods.name: GraphBackendRouter.is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the router has no rules configured.

methods.name: _create_router
methods.description: Creates and caches a GraphBackendRouter instance based on a configuration string.

methods.name: get_backend_override_for_compile_id
methods.description: Determines the backend override for a given compile ID based on configuration rules.
